# Charge card (`charge-card`)

A battery or vehicle charge: level ring, charging rate, time to full, limit and plug state.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createChargeCard` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/chargeCard.d.ts`): `.mh-charge-card`: a battery or vehicle charge. A ring with the level (amber when low, a moving sheen while charging that stops under reduced motion) and the limit tick, the plug state, and the charging power, time to full or to the limit, and one free detail.

```ts
export function createChargeCard(options: ChargeCardOptions): ChargeCardHandle;

export interface ChargeCardOptions {
  /** The thing's name ("Car", "Home battery"); also the card's accessible name. */
  name: string;
  /** `vehicle` (default) or `battery` picks the icon. */
  kind?: 'vehicle' | 'battery';
  /** Leading icon instead of the kind's. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Charge in percent. */
  level: number | null;
  /** The charge limit in percent, marked on the ring; below 100 the time counts to it. */
  limit?: number | null;
  state?: ChargeState | null;
  /** Charging or discharging power in watts. */
  rate?: number | null;
  /** Minutes until full (or until the limit). */
  minutesLeft?: number | null;
  /** One more fact, as given ("Range 240 km"). */
  detail?: string | null;
  /** Below this the level is low (default 20). */
  low?: number;
  /** Smaller ring, for small tiles and watches. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Formats watts (default "7.4 kW"). */
  format?: (watts: number) => string;
  labels?: Partial<ChargeCardLabels>;
}

export interface ChargeCardHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown; the ring moves to the new level. */
  update(options: ChargeCardOptions): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface ChargeCardLabels {
  unplugged: string;
  plugged: string;
  charging: string;
  discharging: string;
  full: string;
  charge: string;
  limit: string;
  /** "to full" after a time. */
  toFull: string;
  /** "to" before the limit after a time ("1 h to 80%"). */
  to: string;
  noData: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createChargeCard, type ChargeCardOptions } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const car: ChargeCardOptions = {
  name: 'Car',
  level: 46,
  limit: 80,
  state: 'charging',
  rate: 7400,
  minutesLeft: 95,
  detail: 'Range 180 km',
};

const card = createChargeCard(car);

// A new reading replaces everything shown; the ring moves to the new level.
setTimeout(() => card.update({ ...car, level: 52, minutesLeft: 78, detail: 'Range 203 km' }), 3000);

document.body.append(card.el);
```
